privateDeals.what: Agreed to sell 100% of Ngoc Hoi Real Estate Investment (with two minority holders) to VinFast Vietnam for VND30.857tn (~$1.2B), at a discount to independent valuation; 50% at closing, rest within 120 days
Approved capital contribution of up to VND10tn (~$396.7M) to VinFast Vietnam via dividend preference shares by end-2026
VinFast to divest Vietnam manufacturing unit VFTP for ~VND13.31tn ($530M) to consortium led by Tuong Lai (asset-light shift); Vuong takes 4.4% of the buyer side
Founded VinEnergo Holding with VND79.76tn ($3.03B) charter capital; Vuong >66%
Co-founded GSM VN Holding (VND43.3tn / $1.65B) with family and Vingroup
Transferred 70.6M VIC shares to VinEnergo and 87.6M VIC shares to VinSpeed as capital contributions

Pledged VND50tn (~$2.1B) personal sponsorship to VinFast alongside Vingroup loans up to VND35tn and conversion of ~VND80tn of loans into preferred shares (backstop funding, goal of profitability by end-2026)

policy.what: VinSpeed seeks to build the ~$61.35B North-South high-speed railway, requesting an 80% zero-interest state loan over 35 years (pending government decision as of mid-2025)

watch.what: Closing of VinFast Vietnam's ~$1.2B purchase of Ngoc Hoi Real Estate from Vuong (related-party deal)
Completion of VinFast's $530M sale of VFTP manufacturing unit to Tuong Lai-led consortium
Vuong's up-to-VND10tn capital contribution into VinFast Vietnam
Generational handover: son Pham Nhat Quan Anh now CEO of VinFast Global, Pham Nhat Minh Hoang CEO of GSM
Possible GSM (Xanh SM) public listing following GSM VN Holding setup
VinFast target of profitability by end-2026 underpinning Vingroup/Vuong funding pledge
